stops.text: 4 NEVERMORE · A Shore of broken pieces — “What if i followed this / trail”
4 NEVERMORE · B The silence — “the waves will / calm to folded whispers”
4 NEVERMORE · C The heart on the sand — “to find a throbbing heart”
4 NEVERMORE · D Trail up the incline — “the midlife / corner we turn toward / the incline—”
4 NEVERMORE · E Night garden field — “into the vast moonlit / night's / garden fields.”
4 NEVERMORE · F Searching for hands — “The clouds mute the stars”
4 NEVERMORE · G Standing in the field — “nevermore.”
